avis.titre: Effective and Gentle K-Beauty Toner for Sensitive, Acne-Prone Skin
avis.texte: As a facial plastic surgeon, I'm always on the lookout for high-quality skincare products that can benefit my patients and myself. When I discovered the numbuzin No.1 Pure-Full Calming Herb Toner, I knew I had to give it a try, especially with the current popularity of K-beauty products. After using this toner every day and night for several weeks, I can confidently say that it has exceeded my expectations. One of my main concerns when trying new skincare products is how they will affect my incredibly sensitive and oily skin, which is prone to breakouts and flaring of underlying rosacea. I'm thrilled to report that the numbuzin toner has not caused any irritation or breakouts during my use. In fact, it has had a soothing effect on my skin, leaving it feeling calm and refreshed after each application. The consistency of this toner is similar to water, making it easy to apply and quickly absorbed by the skin. It has a very minimal scent, which is a plus for those who prefer fragrance-free products or have sensitivities to strong odors. A little goes a long way with this toner, so the 10.14 fl oz bottle is sure to last for quite some time, making it an excellent value for the price. The key ingredient in this toner, Centella Asiatica, is known for its calming and healing properties, which I believe contribute to its effectiveness in soothing my sensitive skin. avis.titre: Gentle, Calming Toner That Works Well for Sensitive, Acne-Prone Skin
avis.texte: I’ve been using the numbuzin No.1 Toner for a while now, and it’s been a really solid addition to my skincare routine. It feels very gentle on the skin and doesn’t cause any stinging or irritation, which is important for me since my skin is sensitive and prone to breakouts. The texture is light and watery, making it easy to apply and quick to absorb without leaving any sticky or heavy feeling behind. I noticed that it helps calm redness and keeps my skin feeling balanced, especially when my skin is feeling stressed or a little oily. It doesn’t strip the skin, but it also doesn’t feel overly moisturizing, which makes it a good everyday toner. I appreciate the ingredient list, especially the centella asiatica and heartleaf, which seem to help soothe irritation and reduce redness over time. The licorice root is a nice bonus, and overall the formula feels well thought out for acne-prone skin. With consistent use, my skin looks calmer and feels less reactive. Overall, this is a gentle, effective toner that does what it claims without being harsh. If you’re looking for something calming and lightweight for sensitive or acne-prone skin, this is a good option that fits easily into a daily routine.

avis.titre: not for me (still a good product though!)
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this toner but I just can’t, I got this toner because as advertised, calms soothes and helps with acne and help nourish and hydrate the skin. I looked at the ingredient list and there’s something in here that my skin does NOT like, I’ve singled this product out multiple times and I finally concluded that when I use this, my skin feels and visibly looks more clogged, and my face just gets more red than it already is which doesn’t help my acne, and not to mention it does a mediocre job at hydrating to. For reference I have oily acne clog prone sensitive skin). But this is just MY experience, I KNOW it’s a good product, it just wasn’t for me, but that’s what makes it so unfortunate because it’s literally advertised for people with my skin type!! However we don’t waste product! I use it on my hands, body, anywhere but my face and it does fine, especially on my hands where I have eczema, I use the toner first and then apply moisturizer and I have not had redness or itchiness!
This toner is an absolute game changer for my sensitive skin!! It's very hydrating and it's a miracle worker for the redness on my face. A solid staple in my skincare routine.

If you have combo oily skin this is a great product. I really noticed a difference even after the first use. My skin was not as oily as it usually gets throughout the day even under sunscreen. It’s lightweight and no alcohol so if your skin is sensitive or acne prone this is great.
This is my regular toner and I love it. I have super red rosacea prone skin so it's great as a base for anything!
No irritation but this product didn't work on my skin. I didn't see any improvement or a change.
